title: Research Project
standfirst: An elective in the PG Diploma in AI and ML. IITM has not published a syllabus for it yet.
syllabus_body_html:
Research Project (DA6006) is one of the elective courses in the PG Diploma in AI and ML, worth 4 credits. The official course page says it is coming soon, and no syllabus has been published yet.

Who can take it: students who have upgraded to the PG Diploma. The upgrade needs a CGPA of 8.0 when you apply, and PG Diploma credits can only be earned after you finish the BS (142 credits).

Where it fits: the PG Diploma is 20 credits, made of 3 core courses (MLOps, Generative AI, Algorithms for Data Science) and 2 electives. The list of electives can change each term.
